in_hebrew.name: Heim
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Home, hearth, shelter
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Heim הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old High German 'heim', meaning 'home' or 'hearth'. In Germanic culture, the hearth was considered the center of the household, providing warmth, sustenance, and protection. This name symbolizes the security and comfort of one's home and family.
